text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Okay. Let's put some pep in that step
and walk to
the other end of your room
one more time.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: One and a two, and a one and a two! ♪

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, dearie.
One, two, one, two...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's it! Look at you go! No stiff knees
are gonna
stop you!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(Yes sirree. And it's not just this nice old
lady...)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: (Everyone's got something they want to give another try.)

text_block_list.name: Acute's Father
text_block_list.text:
Now, focus on the mitts and let loose!
One, two!
One, two!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thwap, thwap! Thwap, thwap!

text_block_list.name: Acute's Father
text_block_list.text:
That's it! Keep it up! You'll make it to
the pros
and be fighting for the belt in
no time!

text_block_list.name: Boxing Student
text_block_list.text:
Right! This is my chance to turn my life
around! I
won't let it go to waste!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(We're all the same, whether you're a
lady getting
on in years or a young man
desperate for a fresh
start in life.)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(We all want another shot, no matter
what it
takes. If my races can give those
people a little
extra inspiration, then...)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Come on, now. I'm right here with you.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: One and a two, and a one and a two! ♪

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text:
My, you're trying extra hard today,
aren't you?
That's the wa—

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume?!
Are you a patient
here?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, goodness, no. I just got a little
turned around
and ended up here.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for the intrusion.
I've actually got a
training session I need to get
to.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Let's have a good session today, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume standing before me is
Wonder
Acute, a dirt racer under my
tutelage. Not only
that...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's the person who helped me push
through a
time when my growth as a
trainer had come to a
standstill.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Back in school, I was a straight-A
student and the
top of my class. But
none of that meant a thing at
Tracen
Academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Forget about producing results—I
couldn't even
find an Umamusume
willing to give the rigorous
training style
I developed a shot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Maybe I'm unfit to be a trainer...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Maybe I'm unfit to be a trainer...)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... I sure am feeling spry today. I'm ready to take on anything you throw my way.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You're always making meticulous
adjustments to
my training regimen in
line with my development.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And you devote countless hours of your
own time
for my sake...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
How could you ever think of yourself as
a failure?
Why, I'm living proof that your
methods are the
genuine article.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite being rejected by every
Umamusume I
tried to scout, Wonder
Acute signed with me and
fully
embraced my training style.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's the sole reason I gained some
confidence
that I could make it as a
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I want to find a way to repay her for
pulling me
back from the brink. This
time, I'll be the one
lending a helping
hand.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Again? Why, of course, dearie.
choice_data_list: アキュート、君の夢をあらためて教えて
アキュート、貴方の夢をあらためて教えて
choice_data_list_en: Acute, tell me about your dream once more.
Acute, tell me your dream once again.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I want to run in the Twinkle Series to
inspire
everyone looking to get their
lives back on track.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Like all the whippersnappers training at
my
father's boxing gym, for example.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: And the sweet old folks doing rehab.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to somehow be a pillar of
strength for
each and every one of them.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There you have it. I want to set an
example of
how working diligently
towards a goal can pay
off, no matter
how long the journey is.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If someone as ordinary as me can make it
to the
pinnacle of dirt racing, then
maybe they can
believe in themselves
too.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer dear. Will you take me to
that
pinnacle I'm aiming for?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Will you take me to meet her?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The person she's referring to is the
person
currently standing at the peak of
dirt racing...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon.
A front runner also known
by the moniker "Silence
Suzuka of the
Sand."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not only is she fast, she also boasts
overwhelming
popularity as an
Umamusume idol—or "Umadol."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She is undeniably a top-tier Umamusume
who
dazzles on and off the track. Even
so...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oho. Can we really pull it off?
choice_data_list_en: Let's catch up to them, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If it's for Wonder Acute, the kindhearted

Umamusume looking to inspire those
trying to
restart their lives, I'll do
anything.
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, let's make your dream come true.
Yeah, let's make that dream come true.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If I possess even the tiniest shred of
talent as a
trainer, I'll use it for her sake.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Why, thank you. Here's a little token of
my
appreciation.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I call them crunch munchies. Let's munch
on these
and get back to work.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Crunch, crunch, crunch...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We sit side-by-side, nibbling on slices of
pickled
daikon radish that strike a
perfect balance
between sweet and
tangy.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I've got this too. It totally slipped
my mind.
Care for a drink?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Slurp...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She brought along tea as well, it seems.
It's a
modest meal, but I feel an
abundance of energy
course through me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of us will use this energy in our
steadfast
climb to the pinnacle of the
dirt-racing world.
